description: This source file defines a static class `GrainMetricsListener` used for monitoring grain metrics within the Orleans runtime. The class manages a collection of grain counts, sets up a MeterListener to observe specific measurement instruments, and handles measurement recording events to update internal counters.

classes.name: GrainMetricsListener
classes.description: A static class responsible for listening to grain-related metrics, maintaining counters, and processing measurement events in Orleans.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the MeterListener to begin listening for metric instruments.

methods.name: OnMeasurementRecorded
methods.description: Callback invoked when a measurement event occurs, updating grain counts based on the measurement value.
